children: said on Wednesday that the Supreme Court of Victoria approved the settlement of class action proceedings over shareholder losses linked to the company's multiple earnings downgrades over nine months ending May 2021.

The New Zealand-based dairy firm added that the full settlement amount of A$62 million ($41.14 million) in the proceedings, will have no impact on its earnings for fiscals 2026 and 2027, as previously announced.
